name: Cable Crunch
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel facing the machine.
Hold the rope beside your face with hips bent slightly.
Breathe out and curl your chest down, bringing elbows toward your thighs.
Pause, then slowly return to the start.
cues: Breathe out as you curl down

common_mistakes.mistake: Sitting back on the heels to move the weight
common_mistakes.fix: Keep the hips high and still; curl only the spine
Lock the hands by the face
Choose a load you can curl slowly for every rep
